title: Day 10: an AI made reversi into a dungeon crawl #shorts
description:
Reversi, but every win takes you one floor deeper.

Reversi Delve is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Each dungeon floor is one game of reversi against a new warden. Win to pick a Flame, Anchor or Hourglass gem, or a relic, then head down to a harder board. How deep can you go before your lamp runs out? A daily dungeon gives everyone the same boards.

Reversi Delve - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video was generated for this channel with Stable Audio. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 11 tomorrow.

#reversi #roguelike #boardgame #puzzle #indiegame
